Ranks Montgomery census tracts by CDC PLACES adult diabetes prevalence, joining tract names and retaining adult population denominator with geoid last for mapping.
sql:
WITH cdc AS (
  SELECT
    tractfips AS geoid,
    CAST(diabetes_crudeprev AS DOUBLE) AS adult_diabetes_prevalence,
    CAST(totalpop18plus AS DOUBLE) AS totalpop18plus,
    CAST(totalpopulation AS DOUBLE) AS totalpopulation
  FROM session.fw_4c28fc_m1_cdc
)
SELECT
  t.name,
  c.adult_diabetes_prevalence,
  c.totalpop18plus,
  c.totalpopulation,
  t.geoid
FROM fw_pg.tracts t
LEFT JOIN cdc c ON t.geoid = c.geoid
ORDER BY c.adult_diabetes_prevalence DESC NULLS LAST, t.name ASC
LIMIT 200
